nodes.title: API_PROMPT
widgets_values: l4cie, a high-angle smartphone photo shot from standing height looking straight down at her as she sits on a beach towel, vertical frame running from the top of her cap to her hips, her body slightly off-centre and leaning toward the right edge, the close wide-angle lens making her head and shoulders sit larger in the frame than her waist and hips. She leans back on both hands planted behind her, shoulders drawn back, chin tipped down, looking up into the lens with a soft closed-lip smile. Her loose hair falls from under the cap down her back, one long section trailing over her right shoulder to the elbow. She wears a faded navy cotton New York Yankees baseball cap with the white embroidered interlocking “NY” logo on the front panel, its curved brim casting a hard shadow across her eyes and forehead, a thin silver chain necklace with a small pendant resting at her collarbone, and a red ribbed string bikini: a halter top tied behind her neck with two small triangle cups worn high and a thin under-string pulled tight across her chest, and matching tie-side bottoms with knotted strings at both hips. Seen straight on, her very large, full, heavy breasts fill the width of her chest, the small cups covering the centre of each, the soft round lower fullness spilling below the string, a deep line of cleavage between them and the halter straps pulled taut by the weight. Pale fine sand with scattered footprints and a few bleached twigs fills the background at the top of the frame, and the edge of a white towel with yellow and teal stripes shows along the left side. Hard midday sun from high in front lights her shoulders and chest and leaves short shadows under the cups and along her ribs. True-to-life colour, phone HDR holding detail in the bright sand, deep focus throughout, and slight JPEG softness.
